notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.106

• DuckAI calls straight away: "ruf Mama an" starts the call (it asks first only when the name was heard a little differently).
• DuckAI writes messages straight away, without the long thinking: "schreib Mama, dass ich später komme", "schick Papa eine Nachricht: bin gleich da", "sag Oma, …", on WhatsApp too, and the same in English.
• DuckWallet never shows a credit or debit card's number, only its last four digits.
• Apps come and go with animations: an app being installed shows its progress in Start, a new app pops in with DuckOS's colours, and a removed app shrinks away while the others slide into its place. "Uninstall" is red in the menu.
• Settings › Passwords moves: the cards come in one after another, lists slide in, a password comes out of a blur when shown, "Copy" turns into "Copied ✓", and a removed password folds away.
• DuckCloud keeps your DuckOS messages too, end-to-end encrypted, so the DuckCloud website can show and send them along with your texts.
